name: search_files
description: Recursively search a path for a regex (or fixed string) and return matching lines as file:line text, or just the file list. Wraps grep; read-only.

pattern.description: Regex to search for (set fixed=true for a literal string).

glob.description: Glob to restrict files, e.g. '*.nim' or '*.py'.

fixed.description: Treat pattern as a literal string, not a regex (default false).

context.description: Lines of context around each match (-C). Ignored when files_with_matches.

context_before.description: Lines of context before each match (-B).

context_after.description: Lines of context after each match (-A).

files_with_matches.description: Return only matching file paths, not lines (default false).
